name: Go Store It Self Storage
notes: Researched from the public Go Store It FAQ and the StoreEase verification menu that My Account links to (no sign-in, no code requested). The portal offers Quick Payment (no login; find your unit; one-time payment; no payment-method or AutoPay changes; for people paying for someone else) or Login to Account (a secure link sent to the account holder's phone; detailed charges, payment methods and autopay, several units and facilities). Modelled as phone identifier, two steps, SMS verification (the real flow is a magic link, not a code). Quick Payment (opened in a browser, nothing submitted) asks for Unit number, Tenant first name and Tenant last name (modelled as accountNumber + lastName, exact; first name is not expressible). FAQ: pay through the online portal or in person; no deposit; autopay can be set up when you rent. No fees, due date, move-out terms or company-wide phone are published.

sources.title: Self Storage Frequently Asked Questions - Go Store It

guest_pay.note: Quick Payment needs no login: enter the unit number and the tenant's first and last name to find the balance, then make a one-time payment. Payment methods and autopay can only be changed after you log in.

cancel_service.note: Moving out is handled by your local Go Store It facility. Contact the facility office to give notice.

help.title: Paying for your unit
paragraphs: Pay through the online payment portal (My Account), or pay in person at your facility. No deposit is needed to rent or reserve a unit.

help.title: Quick Payment or Login
paragraphs: Quick Payment needs no login and suits someone paying on another person's behalf or who cannot find the account: enter the unit number and the tenant's first and last name to find the balance, then make a one-time payment.

Log in to your account when you are the account holder or know the phone number on file. A secure link is sent to that phone, and once in you can see detailed charges and fees, update payment methods or autopay, and handle several units and facilities.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: Go Store It offers autopay. You can set up automatic payments when you open your account, and account holders can change autopay after logging in.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Go Store It does not describe an online move-out. Contact your local facility office to give notice.

extra.intent: Using Go Store It's payment portal help, find whether Quick Payment lets you change autopay. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No. Quick Payment is a one-time payment; log in to change payment methods or autopay.
